system.description: Open Essence 14.2.4 - Shadow Mastery. Spells to create, thicken, curse, and banish shadows and darkness, teleport between shadows, see in the dark, and animate a shadow servant.
Target and all objects on his person appear to be a shadow, and thus are almost invisible in dark areas.
Darkens a 10' radius about the point touched.
Target can see 100' on a normal night as if he were at that location. See Section 7.1.19 in Spell Law.
The caster can pick any shadow in range and may visually perceive as if he were at that location.

Allows the caster to teleport by stepping into one shadow and out of another shadow within range. Both shadows must be in range of and in the line of sight of the caster. Both shadows must be capable of covering the caster.
Causes a 10' radius burst of intense darkness. All targets inside are stunned for one round per 10% failure.
As Dark I, except radius is 50'.

Creates a fog of concentrated shadow in a 10'R that delivers an 'A' Cold critical to those who pass through it. Once created, the fog is affected by the wind and breezes. At the end of the duration, the fog melts away entirely.
Target's shadow is banished. For the duration of this spell the caster has no shadow. People without shadows are often shunned as evil, hunted as servants of the unlife, and are generally mistrusted.
As Enshroud, except the fog is formed into a wall 10' high in a 10' radius about the target, and is not affected by the wind.

When cast in conjunction with a Dark or Enshroud spell, it delays the effects of the other spell until a specific time has passed (up to 24 hrs), or until triggered by a specific event (chosen by the caster at the time of casting).
As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed at all for this spell to work.

Target's shadow has a life of its own. Although the shadow remains with the target, it does not mimic the target's movement (except in a general way). Instead, its specific movements are often grotesque and random.
Darkens a 100' radius about the point touched. Utterdark nullifies all magically and naturally created light.
All shadows in the area of effect are constantly moving and shifting, and bear little if any relation to the actual physical situation.

Caster can animate his own shadow and transform it into a shadow spy. A shadow spy will follow any moderately simple instructions the caster gives it (e.g. follow that man, go to the center of town, look in the next room). It moves at a rate of 100' and cannot travel through solid objects (though they can fit through small openings). They cannot affect any solid object. If the shadow spy has not returned by the end of the spell's duration, it will begin traveling at the rate of 500' per round to return to the caster. When the shadow spy returns the caster sees everything that the shadow spy witnessed. While the caster is 'reliving' what the shadow saw, he is in a trance-like state. As long as the caster's shadow is spying, he will not project a shadow.

As Shadow Spy, except the shadow may interact with the environment and has the following combat statistics: AT 4; DB [half the caster's]; Hits [half the caster's]; Melee Attack [half the caster's best OB]. The shadow warrior can only be affected by magical attacks. If destroyed, the caster takes 50% of his remaining hits and the caster's shadow will not return for 1 week.

As Shadow Servant, except the shadow also has half the caster's PPs (the PPs he has remaining after casting this spell). The shadow can cast spells from any one list that the caster knows (the list must be designated when this spell is cast).
Caster can use one lower level spell on this list each round.
